derivedFrom: templates/templates.json and sections/*.json constraints (recomputed by verify_all.py)

rules.description: A page has at most one HERO section. Templates that genuinely carry more are named in `exceptions`.
No section appears more often on one page than it does in any measured template.
Sections that opened every template they appear in must be the first node.
Sections that closed every template they appear in must be the last node.
These sections were never observed back-to-back.
Two different sections of the same category should not sit next to each other unless that exact pair was observed (named exceptions).
No page has more animated sections than the most animated measured page.
